pipeline.title: Eight Trends Reshaping Patient-Centric Drug Development
pipeline.summary: Exclusive insights from the Patients as Partners Advisory Board on the biggest challenges and opportunities shaping patient engagement, patient advocacy, clinical trial participation, trust, transparency, and patient-focused drug development.

pipeline.title: AZ's R&D chief Barr touts internal 'science success story' after IL-33 antibody's stellar showing in COPD
pipeline.summary: With a detailed data drop that AstraZeneca’s R&D chief describes as an internal “science success story,” the British Big Pharma has secured an FDA priority review for what it believes could become a flagship biologic in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

pipeline.title: Novo Nordisk’s Wegovy helps free 40% of kids from obesity in phase 3 trial
pipeline.summary: Novo Nordisk has reported a phase 3 weight-management win for Wegovy in children, with two out of five kids no longer classified as having obesity after receiving the GLP-1 drug for 68 weeks.

pipeline.title: FDA approves AstraZeneca’s Etcamah, opening ctDNA-guided treatment paradigm in breast cancer
pipeline.summary: In a rare divergence from its own expert panel, the FDA has granted accelerated approval to AstraZeneca’s camizestrant, turning a contentious regulatory review into a landmark win that opens a new treatment paradigm for molecular-guided cancer care.

pipeline.title: Spyre's 3-pronged IBD strategy on track as IL-23 antibody rounds off trio of phase 2 wins
pipeline.summary: Spyre's three-pronged approach to inflammatory bowel disease continues to pay off, with the biotech's anti-IL-23 antibody notching a phase 2 win.

pipeline.title: Pharvaris' latest phase 3 win builds case for HAE drug with FDA verdict pending
pipeline.summary: Pharvaris’ deucrictibant has tasted success in a second phase 3 study, strengthening the case for the therapy to treat hereditary angioedema patients as the Swiss biotech awaits an FDA approval decision.

pipeline.title: Bristol Myers’ pivotal CAR-T multiple myeloma trial hits primary endpoint
pipeline.summary: A pivotal trial of Bristol Myers Squibb’s GPRC5D-directed CAR-T cell therapy has hit its primary endpoint, furthering the drugmaker’s efforts to challenge Johnson & Johnson for the post-BCMA multiple myeloma market.

pipeline.title: Novartis stock slides as centerpiece of $12B Avidity buyout flunks ‘crucial’ phase 3 test
pipeline.summary: The phase 3 Harbor trial of Novartis’ del-desiran has missed its primary endpoint, dealing a major blow to an asset that the Swiss drugmaker acquired in the $12 billion takeover of Avidity Biosciences. The flop leaves Novartis with one win and two failures from a rapid-fire run o

pipeline.title: Inhibrx CEO says progression-free survival data leave ‘no question’ about OX40 agonist’s durability
pipeline.summary: Inhibrx Biosciences’ CEO has argued that the 9.6 months of progression-free survival demonstrated by its OX40 agonist in a phase 2 study has proven the therapy’s durability in treating head and neck cancer.

pipeline.title: Novo’s blockbuster hopes for CKD program dwindle after more phase 3 trials scrapped
pipeline.summary: Novo Nordisk has given up on two more phase 3 trials of ziltivekimab, further eroding prospects for a molecule analysts once tipped as a potential blockbuster.

pipeline.title: AbbVie-backed ADARx plans IPO to bankroll array of clinical-stage siRNA therapies
pipeline.summary: ADARx has reinvigorated its ambitions to go public as the AbbVie-backed biotech looks to fund ongoing clinical trials of a range of next-gen small interfering RNA medicines.

pipeline.title: Roivant’s $14M bet on Bayer’s inhaled hypertension med pays off with phase 2 win
pipeline.summary: Roivant’s $14 million bet on a pulmonary hypertension drug from Bayer appears to have paid off as the inhaled med aced a phase 2 lung disease study.

pipeline.title: Novartis, Ionis drug failure spurs questions about an emerging class of heart medicines
pipeline.summary: Pelacarsen didn’t protect heart health despite lowering levels of a protein particle, “Lp(a),” in a large clinical trial — a surprise result with important implications for cardiovascular drug research.

pipeline.title: Ionis’ rare neurology drug approved; Pfizer inks an ADC deal
pipeline.summary: Zanvastro is now the first approved medicine for Alexander disease. Elsewhere, an immune system specialist posted positive results and a cell therapy developer turned to layoffs.

pipeline.title: AbbVie’s bispecific T-cell engager shows promise in ph. 3 multiple myeloma trial
pipeline.summary: AbbVie released positive phase 3 data Thursday showing that its bispecific T-cell engager etentamig improved response rates and progression-free survival in patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.

pipeline.title: Six AI agents, one deskside system: A new model for clinical decision support
pipeline.summary: Multi-agent AI reasoning at the point of care, with complete data sovereignty built in.

pipeline.title: Roivant surges on ‘exceptional’ results; Bristol Myers touts first-of-its-kind CAR-T therapy
pipeline.summary: One analyst views Roivant’s pulmonary hypertension drug as a future $10 billion-plus seller. Elsewhere, AstraZeneca overcame a negative advisory committee vote and Pharvaris claimed success in a key study.

pipeline.title: Sandoz sets sights on 100 biosimilars in new 2040 strategy, with $300M facility build
pipeline.summary: Spying a “golden decade” beyond the branded drug industry’s looming patent cliff, Sandoz is making big bets on its biosimilar capabilities in the coming years.

pipeline.title: Moonwalk reloads with $70M and new RNAi prospects for obesity
pipeline.summary: The California biotech plans to bring its first drug, enabled by licensing technology from a Chinese drugmaker, into clinical testing for obesity by the end of 2027.

pipeline.title: Amgen’s DLL3-targeted Imdelltra scores overall survival win in first-line small cell lung cancer
pipeline.summary: While Amgen gave no numerical results from Imdelltra's latest overall survival win in first-line small cell lung cancer, R&D chief Jay Bradner said data suggest the DLL3 bispecific “will further revolutionize the standard for survival earlier in the treatment journey.”

pipeline.title: Drug pricing policy ‘earthquake’ forcing rethink of global commercialization plans: survey
pipeline.summary: Shifts in drug pricing and market access policies around the world have caused an “earthquake” that will reverberate for years to come, a survey of industry leaders found.

pipeline.title: Novartis RNA drug falls short in rare muscle disease study
pipeline.summary: The failure of “del-desiran,” which Novartis got through a $12 billion acquisition, could raise questions about the company’s business development acumen, according to one analyst.

pipeline.title: Boston Scientific recalls spinal cord implant in wake of more than 1k serious injuries
pipeline.summary: Boston Scientific has issued another recall, this time for its spinal cord implant used to treat pain.

pipeline.title: BrainChild hauls in $116M to make cell therapies for childhood brain cancers
pipeline.summary: Spun out of research at Seattle Children’s Hospital, the startup has brought a CAR-T treatment for a rare and deadly pediatric cancer into mid-stage testing.

pipeline.title: Roche sweeps neurology corporate reputation rankings once again
pipeline.summary: Roche has retained its status as the neurology drugmaker that patient groups hold in the highest esteem, once again completing a clean sweep of PatientView’s corporate reputation rankings.

pipeline.title: UCB turns to art for ‘Expressing Epilepsy’ awareness campaign
pipeline.summary: Belgian biopharma UCB is seeking to boost awareness of what epilepsy looks like to patients, literally, with a new campaign using art to tell their stories.

pipeline.title: BrainChild Bio masterminds $116M series A for CAR-T's pivotal push in pediatric brain cancer
pipeline.summary: A startup spawned from Seattle Children’s Hospital has raised a $116 million series A to advance cell therapies for devastating childhood brain tumors.

pipeline.title: Boston Scientific cyberattack likely to have ‘material impact’ on financial results
pipeline.summary: The recent cyberattack on Boston Scientific is looking more serious than the medtech major first thought, with the company predicting a possible hit to its third-quarter and full-year results.

pipeline.title: Ardelyx launches first connected TV ad for GI drug Ibsrela
pipeline.summary: Ardelyx is running a new ad campaign for its irritable bowel syndrome with constipation drug, Ibsrela, across connected TV.

pipeline.title: Guardant wins FDA nod for diagnostic guiding use of AstraZeneca’s Etcamah
pipeline.summary: Hot on the heels of the approval of AstraZeneca’s breast cancer drug Etcamah, Guardant Health has been given the green light for its companion diagnostic.

pipeline.title: Novartis Lp(a) drug fails to lower cardiovascular risk in closely watched ph. 3 trial
pipeline.summary: Novartis’ Ionis-partnered drug designed to lower levels of Lp(a), a known cardiovascular risk factor, failed to reduce patients’ risk of a heart attack, stroke, or other major cardiovascular event in the first late-stage test for a drug meant to tackle the mysterious molecule.

pipeline.title: Sanofi enlists another celeb mom in actress Keke Palmer to spread the Beyfortus word
pipeline.summary: Keke Palmer joins Sanofi to share her decision to immunize her son with Beyfortus ahead of the coming respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) season.

pipeline.title: AZ leans on AI-generated llama to promote LAMA combo inhaler Breztri in new campaign
pipeline.summary: The Breztri ad prompts viewers to "put a LAMA to work" by depicting an AI-generated llama and his barnyard colleagues working a late night in the office.

pipeline.title: Trailing rivals, AbbVie scores win with dual-acting myeloma drug
pipeline.summary: The drugmaker is leaning on a better side effect profile compared to drugs from J&J, Pfizer and Regeneron as it pushes etentamig toward FDA submission.

pipeline.title: This week in charts: China deals, stock flatlines and Lilly’s M&A spree
pipeline.summary: Deals with Chinese drugmakers are continuing at a steady pace, while two mid-cap biotechs' stock prices took a tumble this week. Meanwhile, Lilly has outpaced other pharmas in dealmaking this year.

pipeline.title: Ionis’ ‘breakthrough’ Alexander disease approval establishes pillar of rare disease pipeline
pipeline.summary: After Jenny Pearson’s daughter Elise first had a seizure at 16 months old, an MRI came back clean—her brain “looked beautiful,” Pearson recalled to Fierce. But a follow-up scan a year later, just days before Thanksgiving, showed her frontal lobe was now awash in white splotches.

pipeline.title: Daiichi unit American Regent recalls 3 epinephrine batches on particulate, leakage concerns
pipeline.summary: Daiichi Sankyo subsidiary American Regent is launching a recall of three lots of generic epinephrine as it becomes one of the latest manufacturers to face headaches over particulate contamination in its drug products.

pipeline.title: Menarini signs $771M deal to take Gan & Lee GLP-1 to European market
pipeline.summary: Italian company the Menarini Group has agreed to pay Chinese insulin maker Gan & Lee Pharmaceuticals €62 million ($72 million) up front to collaborate on the registration and commercialization of Gan & Lee’s GLP-1 bofanglutide.

pipeline.title: The people who stayed with the problem
pipeline.summary: In this week’s episode of “The Top Line,” we look at the people who kept working the problem, from scientists pushing past long-standing limits in cancer and protein design to physicians and public health leaders tackling trust, misinformation, vaccine policy and representation i

pipeline.title: UCB’s Bimzelx comes from out of the blue to claim August’s top pharma ad spending spot
pipeline.summary: Move over AbbVie and Johnson & Johnson, we have a new and surprising leading drug in the pharma ad spending space.

pipeline.title: Fierce Pharma Asia—Roche, GSK, Novartis billion-dollar deals; More MFN sign-ups; Akeso’s OS win
pipeline.summary: GSK, Roche and Novartis continued their dealmaking spree with Asian companies. Three midsized Asian biopharmas reached MFN deals with the White House. Akeso and Summit's ivonescimab delivered a head-to-head overall survival win against Keytruda. And more.

pipeline.title: Chutes & Ladders—Invivyd's chairman adds CEO role ahead of COVID readout
pipeline.summary: Infectious-disease biotech Invivyd has appointed its current chairman, Marc Elia, as CEO.

pipeline.title: Fresenius unit dinged in FDA warning letter flagging 'complaint trend' from customers
pipeline.summary: Following a string of customer complaints, a Form 483 and a recall this past spring, a Fresenius manufacturing unit in Utah is contending with a warning letter from the FDA.

pipeline.title: Novartis puts MS advocacy on the podium through social media partnership with British Olympian
pipeline.summary: The social media collaboration ties into Novartis' "you know your MS best" messaging, which encourages patients to keep track of changes in their disease.

pipeline.title: An AI drug specialist zeroes in on rare forms of obesity
pipeline.summary: Superluminal Medicines banked $60 million in funding to support development of a drug designed to work similarly to — but potentially be more selectively than — Rhythm Pharmaceuticals’ marketed medicine Imcivree.

pipeline.title: Psilocybin proves promising in neuropathic pain mouse study
pipeline.summary: Amid the rise of psychedelics in the mental health space, researchers have begun to explore psilocybin as a treatment for chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy.

pipeline.title: Pfizer offloads scrapped Seagen ADC to Medicus Pharma in up to $1B+ deal
pipeline.summary: Pfizer has found a new home for an antibody-drug conjugate it acquired in its $43 billion Seagen buyout and dropped earlier this year.

pipeline.title: FDA files reveal lingering concerns, contrasting views behind Replimune melanoma nod
pipeline.summary: Two votes of confidence from leaders at the FDA’s Office of Clinical Evaluation and the Oncology Center of Excellence sealed Replimune’s fate, overruling review staffers’ concerns and paving the way for last month’s accelerated nod for Tudriqev.

pipeline.title: Akeso, Summit’s ivonescimab extends lives in Keytruda head-to-head trial. What now?
pipeline.summary: About two years ago, a head-to-head progression-free survival win made Akeso and Summit’s ivonescimab—and the PD-1xVEGF class—the most promising agent to replace Keytruda. Now, that same trial has met its overall survival endpoint, but to a far more measured reception.

pipeline.title: CMI boosts medical affairs capabilities with new specialty communications unit
pipeline.summary: The new business unit is centered on four core capabilities, which includes AI-enhanced scientific intelligence, omnichannel "scientific ecosystems," and more.

pipeline.title: Building the Data Foundation for AI-Driven Clinical Development
pipeline.summary: H1 is transforming clinical development with connected intelligence that improves study design, accelerates execution, and reduces cost and patient burden

pipeline.title: ESC: Amgen CMO flags Repatha 'inflection' amid new data on mortality benefit
pipeline.summary: On the back of a heart-helping win for the 11-year-old Repatha last fall, Amgen has continued to deepen the evidence on its PCSK9 inhibitor’s ability to cut cardiovascular risks in many patients.

pipeline.title: Why Roche is 'really excited' about a UCN2 analog for obesity after seeing preclinical data
pipeline.summary: Roche has decided to pay $190 million upfront for an unusual obesity mechanism after viewing preclinical data that “clearly suggests” the modality can reduce weight while preserving lean muscle, Fierce has learned.

pipeline.title: A year on from Big Pharma’s pull-back from the UK, has anything changed?
pipeline.summary: September 2025 marked a low point for relations between the U.K. government and Big Pharma. Fierce reached out to the companies involved to see if they've softened their stance.

pipeline.title: From Question to Action: Rethinking Pharma Engagement in the AI Era
pipeline.summary: As AI reshapes health discovery, GoodRx is helping pharma turn consumer and HCP questions into action.

pipeline.title: The Oral GLP-1 Tracker: Novo's Wegovy pill, Lilly's Foundayo grow scripts
pipeline.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.

pipeline.title: Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker '26: Brainchild conjures $116M; Moonwalk steps into $70M
pipeline.summary: The Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker records venture capital rounds of $50 million or more secured by biotechs.
